title: role-claim normalization failure: SAML attribute scoping broke RBAC/KMS audit envelope
creator: Aisha Khanna
description: Summary: After the 2026-03-08 private control-plane update, certain SAML IdPs started receiving role assignment failures. Root cause: role-claim normalization pipeline lowercased and trimmed scoped attributes (e.g. 'app:Admin' -> 'app:admin'), which collided with RBAC role keys that are case-sensitive in the private runtime. Additionally, the KMS audit envelope signing path skipped the legacy-audit-key fallback when normalization altered the attribute name, resulting in missing audit entries for affected assertions. Two enterprise customers reported denied access for service accounts and incomplete audit trails. Scope: affects customers on private control plane versions >= private-2026.03.08 using SAML attribute scoping patterns and the KMS legacy-fallback path. Impact: inability to resolve tenant role bindings, intermittent 403s for background workloads, and gaps in audit logs (authz decisions missing).
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha K: Triage call with on-call, reproduced with CustomerA SAML assertion dump. Created minimal repro and flagged P0. Notified CS and assigned to Marco.

2026-03-10 - Marco R: Reproduced locally by crafting SAML response with scoped attribute 'Finance:Admin'. Observed normalization function lowercasing scope segment. Added logs and a unit test showing original vs normalized values. Link to repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/priv-control-plane/issues/987

2026-03-11 - Marco R: Implemented patch to preserve scope segment casing during normalization and to add strict equality fallback in role resolver. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/priv-control-plane/pull/2345 (WIP).

2026-03-11 - Security Eng (T. Nguyen): Quick review: primary risk is introducing a casing-sensitive path where IdPs may vary. Recommend adding feature-flag gated rollout and a compat-mode that accepts either casing for 30 days and emits a deprecation audit entry.

2026-03-12 - Marco R: Added KMS audit fix: ensure audit-envelope signer tries both normalized and original attribute name when looking up legacy audit keys. Added integration test that replays assertion and verifies audit entry present. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/priv-control-plane/pull/2345

2026-03-12 - QA (L. Patel): Running canary against staging cluster with CustomerA corp-id. Observed successful role resolution for previously failing assertions and audit entries present. Noted one failure when IdP sends attributes with unexpected whitespace — added trimming step to normalization to handle this case.
2026-03-12 - PM (S. Lewis): Customer communications drafted and sent to CS draft channel. Recommended remedial credits for impacted customers and offer post-mortem call after release.
2026-03-12 - Next steps: complete security review, land PR behind feature flag, canary deploy to 5% of private tenants, monitor 48h for authz errors and audit coverage, then full rollout.
